_doc: LENS: the anamorphic blockbuster look, built into the Studio. The image-to-video model copies what it SEES in the keyframe far more than what it READS in the prompt, so the look is baked into the plates (Image screen) and then held with short text locks appended to every prompt. Stage templates fill the prompt box; {field} slots take the user's words or the field's default. Locks are saved per project by the Studio in lens.local.json (git-ignored). Prompts describe the look and never name camera, lens or film brands.

locks.realism: True-to-life skin with visible pores, fine texture and natural imperfections, real fabric weight and wear, real-world materials. Indistinguishable from a real photograph, no CGI look, no plastic or airbrushed skin, no 3D render or cartoon look.
locks.realism_video: Real live-action footage: true-to-life skin texture with pores and natural imperfections, real-world materials, weight and physics. No CGI look, no plastic or airbrushed skin, no 3D animation or cartoon look.
locks.lens: 2.39:1 widescreen, vintage anamorphic character, elongated vertical oval bokeh, shallow focus with motivated rack focus, soft focus fall-off and a slight bend toward the frame edges, one restrained horizontal lens flare, organic 35mm film grain, no CGI cleanliness.
locks.shadow_side: Shoot the shadow side: key light from beyond the subject, camera on the unlit side of the face. High contrast, strong falloff from light to shadow, rim light separating subject from background. Shadows hold texture and faces stay readable, never crushed to black.
locks.lighting_example: Hard cold-white key from high camera left raking across the faces, warm tungsten practicals as small accents, strong blue rim from behind, deep shadow on the right side that still holds texture, thin haze catching the light. Never warm sunset, never flat overcast, never lifted shadows.

lock_help.realism: Kills the plastic AI skin. Goes on everything. At CFG 1 the negative prompt is ignored, so 'no CGI look' has to live in the prompt itself.
lock_help.lens: The lens profile from your location plates, in words. Use on location plates, lighting plates and shots. Off for character sheets.
lock_help.lighting: Describe what your lighting plates share: key source and direction, colour temperatures, contrast, shadow depth, rim, haze, practicals. End with a NEVER line. Reuse it word for word for every shot in this location.
lock_help.shadow_side: Hero close-ups, dialogue, night, interiors, tension. Skip it for comedy, daylight wides and fast action.

focal.label: 24mm · establishing, about 84°
focal.note: Locations and establishing shots. Never on a face.

focal.label: 35mm · hero object or depth layers, about 63°
focal.note: Location with a hero object or layers of depth.

stages.label: 1 · Character sheet
tips: Light sheets evenly. The drama comes from the lighting plates later.
Generate wide, select narrow: run many seeds, keep the best, lock it.
One or two generations max. Every chained edit softens the face, and that mush carries into the film.
Nail the face close-up once; the body panels can take revisions.
Test the sheet in motion (a Draft render) before you approve it. About half of stills that look fine fall apart in motion.
Only use a real person's face with their written consent.

fields.label: Name
fields.placeholder: e.g. Marco Farola

fields.label: Age, build, one-line design signature
fields.placeholder: e.g. late 40s, heavy-set, grey stubble, scar through the left eyebrow
fields.default: an adult with a distinctive, specific face

fields.label: Costume details to show
fields.placeholder: e.g. worn leather jacket collar, gold ring, scuffed boots

stages.template: Character reference sheet of {name}, {who}. Panels on a neutral mid-grey seamless backdrop: full body front, three-quarter, profile, back; one large face close-up panel; costume detail inserts of {items}. Face panel framed like a portrait lens at close distance, body panels like a normal lens. Soft even studio light, true-to-life skin with pores and fine texture, real fabric weight and wear. Identical face, costume and proportions in every panel. Photoreal, no CGI look, no text, no watermark.

stages.label: 2 · Anamorphic location plate
tips: Pick the lens before the shot: 24mm establishing, 35mm hero object or depth, 40mm tight interiors.
Write every lens trait as something you can see, named on what it sits on.
One flare, one source, restrained. A blown-out flare plate can't drive a scene.
Clean plate, no characters. The cast comes in later.

fields.label: Location in one line
fields.placeholder: e.g. a narrow brick alley behind a Texas bar

fields.label: Mood
fields.placeholder: e.g. tense, late night

fields.label: In frame, foreground to background
fields.placeholder: e.g. a puddle and a crate, the back door under a caged bulb, the street glowing at the far end
fields.default: a foreground object, the main subject area, and deep background

fields.label: Palette (60 / 30 / 10)
fields.placeholder: e.g. 60% wet charcoal, 30% sodium orange, 10% cold cyan
fields.default: 60% deep neutral shadow, 30% warm practical light, 10% cold accent

fields.label: Light: source, colour, direction, contrast
fields.placeholder: e.g. one sodium streetlight high camera right, hard and warm, high contrast
fields.default: one motivated hard source from the side, high contrast

fields.label: Focus locked on
fields.placeholder: e.g. the caged bulb over the back door

fields.label: What melts in the foreground
fields.placeholder: e.g. the crate

fields.label: What dissolves in the background
fields.placeholder: e.g. the street at the far end

fields.label: Bokeh sits on
fields.placeholder: e.g. the wet pavement and distant signs

fields.label: Flare source
fields.placeholder: e.g. the caged bulb

fields.label: Real physics
fields.placeholder: e.g. light rain backlit in visible streaks

stages.template: Cinematic film still. {place}, {mood}. Three-quarter angle, camera set to one side looking diagonally into the depth, lens at {height}. In frame, foreground to background: {layers}. Palette: {palette}. Light: {light}. Focus locked on {focus}, camera {distance} m from it, lens wide open; {fg} melts into creamy out-of-focus, {bg} dissolves into soft blur; anamorphic bokeh with elongated vertical oval highlights on {bokeh_on}; one restrained horizontal {flare_color} streak flare off {flare_source}; soft focus fall-off and a slight bend toward the frame edges. Shot on real 35mm film, {stock} colour negative grain, anamorphic {focal}mm lens. Realistic physics: {physics}. Indistinguishable from a real photograph, no CGI look. Clean environment plate, no characters. No text, no watermark, no logo. Aspect ratio 2.39:1.

stages.label: 3 · Lighting plate
tips: One dominant key with a clear direction and a hard edge.
Shoot from the shadow side: key beyond the subject, camera on the unlit side.
Deep shadow that still holds texture. Crushed black reads as a mistake.
Also make a sky or world plate, so interiors and exteriors share one light.
When you have a few plates you like, describe what they share in the project's Lighting lock.

fields.placeholder: e.g. the bar's back office

fields.label: Key colour temperature
fields.placeholder: e.g. cold white

fields.label: Key direction
fields.placeholder: e.g. high camera left

fields.label: Raking across
fields.placeholder: e.g. the desk, the wood panelling

fields.label: Backlight colour
fields.placeholder: e.g. blue

fields.label: Rimming
fields.placeholder: e.g. the chair and the window frame

fields.label: Practicals
fields.placeholder: e.g. a green banker's lamp, a TV glow

fields.label: Haze or steam

stages.template: Lighting reference plate of {place}. Hard directional {key_temp} key from {key_dir} raking across {surfaces}; strong {rim_color} backlight rimming {rim_edges}; deep shadow on the {shadow} with readable texture; {practicals} as small warm accents; {haze} catching the light in visible shafts. Key from beyond the subject, camera on the shadow side. High contrast, low-key exposure, natural material colour. No characters, no text.

stages.label: 4 · Shot (this Studio)
tips: The keyframe is the look. Build it on Image with the plates first, then animate it here.
Busy scenes: fewer words. A two-hander on a master frame can carry more detail.
Keep it under the token limit; Wan ignores anything past about 512 tokens.

fields.label: Who
fields.placeholder: e.g. the man in the leather coat

fields.label: What happens
fields.placeholder: e.g. turns slowly toward the door as it creaks open

fields.label: Focus
fields.placeholder: e.g. rack focus from his hand to his eyes
fields.default: focus stays on the subject's eyes

stages.template: {who} {action}. {focus}. Natural, weighty, real-world motion; breathing and small micro-movements; hair and clothing move with real physics.

stages.label: 5 · Seedance prompt (copy to Higgsfield)
tips: For when a shot needs to look like Higgsfield: build the plates here, then attach them in Higgsfield in this order.
Each reference gets ONE scoped line: what to take and what NOT to take.
You don't have to use a whole frame. Take a slice: just the blocking, just the light, just the lens.

fields.label: @Image1 character
fields.placeholder: e.g. Marco

fields.label: What happens
fields.placeholder: e.g. Marco steps out the back door and lights a cigarette, watching the street

fields.label: Camera
fields.placeholder: e.g. slow push in at chest height, rack focus from the lighter to his eyes

stages.template: @Image1 - {char}: face and costume identical throughout. @Image2 - location plate: set design and lens character only; framing is free. @Image3 - lighting plate: light direction, colour and contrast only; do not copy its composition, framing or set. {action}. {camera}.

fixes.problem: Skin looks plastic, waxy or airbrushed
fixes.fix: Turn on the Realism lock. Remake the keyframe instead of editing it (every chained edit softens skin). Use a photoreal stills model for text-only stills (see docs/PHOTOREAL.md).
fixes.add: True-to-life skin with visible pores, fine texture and natural imperfections.

fixes.fix: Name a focus point, put the camera 1 to 3 m from it, and say the lens is wide open.
fixes.add: Focus locked on one named point, camera 2 m from it, lens wide open; foreground and background melt into soft blur.

fixes.fix: Write elongated vertical oval highlights and name what they sit on.
fixes.add: Anamorphic bokeh with elongated vertical oval highlights on the distant lights.

fixes.fix: One source only, say restrained, and make the source less bright.
fixes.add: One restrained horizontal streak flare off a single dim source.
Rectilinear 35mm perspective, straight lines stay straight.

fixes.fix: A person was put on 24mm. Switch the shot to 50mm or 85mm framing.
fixes.add: Face framed like a portrait lens at a natural distance, no wide-angle distortion.

fixes.problem: Shots go flat or evenly lit
fixes.fix: The lighting lock is missing or too soft. Name the key direction and the deep shadow side. Still flat? Add the Shadow side block, and make sure the lighting plate was shot from the shadow side.
fixes.add: Hard directional key light, deep shadow on one side of the face.

fixes.fix: Add a NEVER line to the lighting lock.
Keep the shadow side but ask for texture in the shadows and a gentle bounce.
fixes.add: Shadows hold texture, faces readable, gentle bounce on the shadow side.

fixes.fix: Too many chained edits. Go back to the earliest clean generation and work from that.
A product or brand name crept into the prompt. Replace it with a description of the look.
fixes.add: No text, no logos, no brand marks.

fixes.problem: Motion is slow-motion, floaty or barely moves
fixes.fix: A known side effect of the 4-step speed LoRA. Pick Pace: real time, describe the action with strong verbs, and see docs/PHOTOREAL.md for the 3-pass sampler setup.
fixes.add: Everything moves at natural, real-time speed with weight and momentum.

fixes.problem: Motion looks smooth and synthetic (the 'AI' feel)
fixes.fix: Turn on Film finish (grain). Use Camera feel: handheld. Ask for small imperfect micro-movements. Raise the frame rate in post (docs/PHOTOREAL.md).
fixes.add: Slight natural handheld drift, small imperfect micro-movements, breathing.
